title: Enhanced mechanical properties of lightweight refractory high-entropy alloys at elevated temperatures via Si addition
process_description: prepared by DHL-500 II non-consumable vacuum arc melting of pure (≥ 99.9 wt%) elements in a Ti-gettered argon atmosphere, remelted at least 5 times to ensure chemical homogeneity, with current gradually loaded to 300 A and maintained for 2 min to ensure sufficient melting of the raw materials.
